text:
anya: Heads-up: scheduling a minimal-base rebuild + signing window next Tue 2026-01-20. Need quick alignment on RBAC change, audit sinks, and smoke/rollback rules.
vikram: OK. Who will request the KMS binding and for how long?
sam: Proposal: 2 hour signer window. Build runner gets `roles/cloudkms.signer` for that period only. We revoke immediately after.
anya: +1. We should capture the approver in Confluence and attach the PR. Also record the exact IAM delta in the audit entry.
vikram: I'll own adding/removing the binding. Command I'll use: ```gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/image-keys/cryptoKeys/signer --member="serviceAccount:svc-image-builder@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/cloudkms.signer"```
vikram: Revoke command: ```gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/image-keys/cryptoKeys/signer --member="serviceAccount:svc-image-builder@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/cloudkms.signer"```
sam: We'll need an auditable approval step. I'll make a tiny approvals PR template and require one engineer + one security approver.
anya: Audit checklist: 1) IAM change -> log sink to `projects/redwood-logs/sinks/kms-iam`; 2) Key usage logs -> SIEM rule `kms-usage`; 3) Artifact signing events -> Artifact Registry metadata + `containeranalysis` -> SIEM.
ops-bot: Reminder created: `2026-01-20T08:40:00Z` posting to #eng-security 20m before window.
vikram: For vuln gating: run `trivy fs --format json --severity CRITICAL,HIGH ./rootfs` and `grype sbom:sbom.json -o json` after SBOM. Block if any CRITICAL.
sam: We'll attach the SBOM (syft) and the trivy/grype outputs to the release PR. Add an automated check to fail the release if CRITICAL found.
anya: Runtime canary: deploy canary with 2 pods, 3m warmup, hit `/health` and a small infer endpoint. If >7% errors in 5m, auto-rollback.
vikram: Which image signature tooling? We use cosign + attestation via rekor. Ensure cosign public key is uploaded to keyserver and stored in AR metadata.
sam: Add these steps to the build: `cosign sign --key ksm://projects/.../cryptoKeys/signer@1 --output-signature sig` then `cosign attest --type provenance ...`
anya: Also please ensure SBOM is stored as build artifact and that signatures reference the SBOM hash.
vikram: Ops runbook snippet for rollback: ```- if canary_err_rate > 7% -> scale down new release -> scale up last-signed image (tagged :signed-vN) -> revoke KMS binding if still present -> open incident #release-war-room -> notify eng-oncall```
sam: We should also have an immediate abort condition: if any post-scrub CRITICAL vuln appears that wasn't present pre-scrub, abort and rollback.
anya: Agree. We'll capture pre-scrub and post-scrub baselines. sam, please add pipeline step to diff the two and fail if new CRITICALs.
sam: On it. I'll push a small lambda that diffs trivy outputs and posts results to S3 and creates JIRA tickets for new CRITICALs.
vikram: Security question: do we need an ephemeral KMS key instead of giving signer role to builder SA? That would avoid long-lived binding but needs more infra. Thoughts?
anya: Ephemeral key would be ideal but higher infra work. For now, temporary RBAC window + strict logging + auto-revoke is acceptable. Let's note ephemeral-key work as follow-up.
sec-bot: Alert rule created: `kms-binding-change` -> posts to #eng-oncall and auto-opens incident when triggered.
ops-bot: Pre-window checklist posted to #eng-security: [PR links, runbook, smoke test, alerts].
vikram: I'll create a PR under `infra/image-signer-window/` with add/remove scripts and a `README.md` that lists exact timeline and approvers.
anya: Final ask: everyone ack when PRs/docs live. Also attach the SBOM + trivy baseline to the confluence page.
sam: ack. I'll add the pipeline PR and the diff lambda.
vikram: ack. Will push scripts and schedule the window.
sec-bot: Reminder scheduled: `2026-01-20T08:40:00Z` -> 20m pre-window notice.
anya: Thanks team. We'll reconvene 24h before to verify everything is green. :thumbsup:
